symptom: A synthetic Node 22.16.0 override of Map.prototype.has/get could make the shadow-evidence validator accept a re-digested taxonomyCounts object with the wrong taxonomy key but the same count and cardinality. The pre-fix taxonomyMatches used a temporary Map for expected counts and consulted mutable Map.has/get during comparison. This was a research-only synthetic integrity case, not a production or external evidence incident.
lesson: The shadow-evidence taxonomy validator can accept a re-signed incorrect reason taxonomy when its expected-count Map is queried through mutable ambient Map methods. A content digest does not replace an independent, deterministic semantic reconciliation.
guardrail: Recompute expected taxonomy counts in a null-prototype own-data dictionary, compare exact own count descriptors and key cardinality, and avoid Map.prototype.has/get/set for the admission verdict. Regression-test a wrong-key re-digested taxonomy under reversible Map hooks while preserving valid synthetic evidence and digest.
